website.data: --> Swimming Pool Leak Detection | Tx Aquadoc top of page Skip to Main Content Home About What We Do Hours of Operation Bucket Test Contact Us Accreditations Our Reviews More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. TX AquaDoc Leader in swimming pool leak detection and repair TX AquaDoc Leak Detection is solely devoted to swimming pool leak detection and underwater repairs. Servicing the greater Dallas/Fort Worth area and beyond. Get In Touch Home: Welcome What We Do Have a leak? Don't freak! There are many swimming pool repair companies, but we specialize in pool leak detection. With our trade knowledge, experience and equipment you can rest assured your leak will be found and fixed properly. Schedule an appointment This is where it all starts. Suspect a leak? Give us a call or use our contact button below to schedule your appointment. Contact us Leak Detection Once you have scheduled your appointment our experts will be onsite to detect exactly where the problem is. Swimming pool leak detection can be tricky, but the experts at TX AquaDoc have seen it all. Contact us Repair Leaking pools and water lines can cause expensive excess water consumption and lead to bigger problems on your property. If you have a leak, you need quick, reliable professionals to find and repair it so you can retain an even water level and stop watching money literally go down the drain. Contact us Home: Services TX AquaDoc Pool leak detection is our specialty! ​ We pride ourselves on providing the most thorough pool leak detection services. We even get calls from other leak detection companies to assist on tough to find leaks. ​ Whether you need a leak repair specialist for a residential swimming pool leak, commercial pool, or spa/tub, TX AquaDoc can identify and repair the leak ​ Contact us! Home: About Have a Leak? Don't freak! Learn how to test for a leak in your pool with a bucket test. Bucket Test Home: Hours of Operation Home: Footer Our Reviews FAQs Frequently asked questions General How to find out if your pool is leaking. Look for wet spots around the pool deck, equipment pad, or yard. Check if the water level drops more than normal evaporation (about 1/4 inch per day in Texas heat). Run the bucket test. Is it normal to loose 1/2 in of water per day in my pool? Normal evaporation is about 1/4 inch per day in Texas summer heat. Half an inch per day is double that. You're losing roughly 3.5 inches per week. That adds up to hundreds of gallons and real money on your water bill. Run the bucket test to be sure. But at that rate, you almost certainly have a leak in your plumbing, skimmer, or shell. Call someone now. The longer it runs, the more it erodes soil under your pool and deck. That turns a small repair into a HUGE problem. How do pool companies find a leak? We start with a visual inspection. Check the equipment, skimmer, returns, and deck for obvious cracks or wet spots. Run a pressure test. A leak detector that listens for the sound of water escaping, sonar or tracer gas. Use dye to drop it near suspected cracks. The whole process takes 1 to 3 hours depending on how hidden the leak is. reviews.text: They were so easy to deal with from beginning to end.They discussed up front the pricing and potential problems that might occur once the work starts in the drilling process. Problems did occur but the next steps were communicated quickly and my options were laid out so I could understand. Great experience already have them booked for another problem.

reviews.text: I am a Realtor and AquaDoc was able to squeeze a leak detection of a pool at my client’s home that we have under contract. They did a great job, were timely, and very courteous.
reviews.author: Danny Peters

reviews.text: We had an underground leak for our pool and contacted aquadoc after many others. They came out quickly and even fixed the issue same day! Very responsive customer service and very kind workers
reviews.author: Kori Lyons

reviews.text: Shane and Chance came out to my house to identify a pool leak. They were polite and professional. The process was explained to me so I knew what to expect. The leak was found and resolved quickly.
reviews.author: Michelle Nunes

reviews.text: TX AquaDoc was very easy to work with for getting a quote and scheduling. Their availability was also a big factor in selecting to work with them. Their experienced technician was timely and very knowledgeable and polite while onsite. They were able to thoroughly explain what my issues were as far as our suspected leak problem and provided a temporary fix for us while we work with the company who remodeled our pool recently to cover the repairs under warranty. I appreciated the detailed report I received for use in relaying our leak problem for warranty repair. They also quoted us for the repairs, should we need it, and the quote seemed reasonable and fair. I would use TX AquaDoc again, 100%, but hopefully we don’t need to!
reviews.author: Betsy Haag

reviews.text: Realized I had a leak on New Year's Day.  I texted them the detail later in the day.  They immediately responded, got some information and gave me a quote.  I accepted and they set a tech the next morning.  Found the leak which was difficult to find.  They gave me a quote for the repair which was reasonable.  From when I texted on a holiday until complete it took less than 24hrs, very impressive!
reviews.author: Peter Waldman

reviews.text: Acqua Doc replaced a leaking skimmer that it was long due. They assessed the issues, gave me a quote( similar to another quote from a different company ) scheduled  the appointment and completed the job in the time they had estimated. They did a good job and I’m not loosing water anymore .
reviews.author: Stefano Broccoli
